description: A colloquium marking the 40th anniversary of the Portuguese Companies Code and the 20th anniversary of its major 2006 reform. VdA's Paulo Olavo Cunha is on the scientific committee and will speak and moderate panels. The event continues in Lisbon after an earlier session in Porto on 26 October.
event_name: Colloquium “Católica and Four Decades of the Portuguese Companies Code”
organizer: Faculty of Law of Universidade Católica Portuguesa
